extra_vocab.en: the act of agreeing to take something that is offered
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於求職與商務信件，表示「接受」錄用、提案或條款，也可指貨物的「驗收」。語氣正式，常搭配 of 後面接被接受的東西。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: acceptance 是名詞，常寫成 acceptance of + 名詞；動詞是 accept，不要寫成 acceptance the offer。

example.en: The company sent him a letter of acceptance on Monday.
example.zh: 公司星期一寄給他一封錄取通知。

example.en: Online banking has gained acceptance among our older customers.
example.zh: 網路銀行已在年長客戶之間獲得認同。

example.en: Clicking this button means acceptance of the terms and conditions.
example.zh: 按下這個按鈕代表接受條款與條件。

examples.en: We are waiting for your acceptance of the job offer.
examples.zh: 我們正在等你接受這份工作邀約。

examples.en: The manager asked for the team's acceptance of the new schedule.
examples.zh: 經理請團隊接受新的時程表。

examples.en: Payment is due within ten days of acceptance of the goods.
examples.zh: 貨物驗收後十天內須付款。

confusable.diff: accept 是動詞「接受」，acceptance 是名詞「接受這件事」。
confusable.usage: accept 是動詞，後面直接接受詞；acceptance 是名詞，要寫成 acceptance of + 名詞。

example.en: Please accept our invitation to the opening event.
example.zh: 請接受我們對開幕活動的邀請。

example.en: We need the manager's approval before we place the order.
example.zh: 下訂單之前，我們需要經理的核准。

example.en: Both companies signed the agreement at yesterday's meeting.
example.zh: 兩家公司在昨天的會議上簽了協議。

derived.link: 基礎動詞，加 -ance 就變成名詞 acceptance，像 perform → performance
un- + acceptable，不能被接受，像 unable、unusual

senses.en: the act of saying yes to an offer or plan

example.en: His acceptance of the offer made everyone in the office happy.
example.zh: 他接受了這份邀約，讓辦公室每個人都很高興。

senses.en: the feeling that something is normal or good
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 among / in 某群人或市場，表示被大家認同。

example.en: The new product slowly won acceptance in the Asian market.
example.zh: 這項新產品慢慢在亞洲市場獲得認同。

senses.en: the act of agreeing that goods are correct
senses.distinguish: 出現在採購、貨物、付款情境，常和 form、goods 一起出現。

example.en: The buyer signed the acceptance form after checking the goods.
example.zh: 買方檢查貨物後簽了驗收單。

extra_vocab.en: to get more and more of something over time
extra_vocab.note: 多益常用在財務、經驗、點數或庫存，表示一點一點慢慢變多。可以是好事（累積經驗），也可以是壞事（累積債務）。

example.en: Dust accumulates quickly on the old warehouse shelves.
example.zh: 灰塵很快就會堆在舊倉庫的架子上。

example.en: She accumulated two weeks of unused vacation by December.
example.zh: 到十二月她累積了兩週沒休的假。

example.en: The accumulated profits were used to buy new equipment.
example.zh: 累積下來的利潤被用來買新設備。

example.en: Orders are accumulating faster than we can process them.
example.zh: 訂單累積的速度比我們處理的速度還快。

example.en: You will accumulate valuable experience in our sales department.
example.zh: 你會在我們的業務部累積寶貴的經驗。

example.en: The company continued to accumulate debt last year.
example.zh: 這家公司去年持續累積債務。

example.en: Members can accumulate points every time they shop with us.
example.zh: 會員每次在我們這裡購物都可以累積點數。

examples.en: Over time, small savings can accumulate into a large amount.
examples.zh: 時間一久，小額儲蓄也能累積成一大筆錢。

examples.en: Our unpaid bills began to accumulate during the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天期間，我們未付的帳單開始越積越多。

examples.en: Interns accumulate useful work experience in just six months.
examples.zh: 實習生在短短六個月內就能累積實用的工作經驗。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近；accommodate 是「容納、為…提供住宿」，accumulate 是「累積」。

example.en: The hotel can accommodate two hundred guests for the event.
example.zh: 這間飯店可以容納兩百位客人參加活動。

similar.diff: collect 是有目的地收集；accumulate 強調隨時間慢慢變多。

example.en: We collect customer feedback after every online purchase.
example.zh: 每次網路購物後，我們都會收集顧客意見。

similar.diff: build up 比較口語，accumulate 比較正式，常見於書面與報告。

example.en: Try to build up your savings before buying a car.
example.zh: 買車之前，試著先把存款累積起來。

example.en: He gained useful skills during his first year here.
example.zh: 他在這裡的第一年學到了很多實用技能。

example.en: The total of all expenses is five thousand dollars.
example.zh: 所有費用的總數是五千美元。

derived.link: accumulate + -ion，把動作變成名詞，像 decorate → decoration

extra_vocab.note: 多放在句首，用逗號隔開，用來補充另一個資訊，常見於電子郵件、公告與報告。語氣比 also 正式，和 in addition 很接近。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: additionally 是副詞，不能直接放在名詞前；要修飾名詞用形容詞 additional（additional cost）。

example.en: Additionally, please note that the office closes at five.
example.zh: 另外請注意，辦公室五點關門。

example.en: Two forms are additionally required for overseas orders.
example.zh: 海外訂單另外還需要兩份表格。

examples.en: Additionally, please attach a copy of your passport.
examples.zh: 另外，請附上你的護照影本。

examples.en: The plan is cheaper. Additionally, it saves a lot of time.
examples.zh: 這個計畫比較便宜。此外，還能省下很多時間。

examples.en: We improved delivery times and, additionally, reduced shipping costs.
examples.zh: 我們縮短了交貨時間，另外也降低了運費。

confusable.diff: additional 是形容詞「額外的」，additionally 是副詞「此外」。
confusable.usage: additional 放在名詞前（additional staff）；additionally 通常放句首或修飾整個句子。

example.en: We need additional staff for the holiday season.
example.zh: 假日期間我們需要額外的人手。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同；in addition 也可接 to + 名詞（in addition to the fee）。

example.en: In addition, we will offer free shipping on all orders.
example.zh: 此外，所有訂單我們都提供免運費。

similar.diff: also 比較口語，位置多在動詞前；additionally 較正式，常放句首。

example.en: We also offer free repairs for the first year.
example.zh: 我們第一年也提供免費維修。

similar.diff: moreover 語氣更正式，常用來加強前面說的論點。

example.en: Moreover, the new model uses much less energy.
example.zh: 而且，新機型用的能源少很多。

example.en: Please pay an extra fee for heavy bags.
example.zh: 過重的行李請另付額外費用。

example.en: Besides, the hotel is too far from the airport.
example.zh: 而且，這間飯店離機場太遠了。

derived.link: 最基本的動詞「加」，其他字都從它長出來
add + -ition，加的動作或加上去的東西，像 compete → competition
addition + -al，變成形容詞，像 tradition → traditional

extra_vocab.en: related to the work of running an office or a company
extra_vocab.note: 多益職場情境很常見，指文書、安排、管理這類辦公室行政工作。常見搭配有 administrative assistant（行政助理）與 administrative fee（手續費）。

example.en: We are hiring an administrative assistant for the front desk.
example.zh: 我們正在為櫃檯招聘一位行政助理。

example.en: A small administrative fee applies to every late payment.
example.zh: 每筆逾期付款都要加收一筆小額手續費。

example.en: Most of my day goes to administrative work and emails.
example.zh: 我一天大部分時間都花在行政工作和電子郵件上。

example.en: Visit the administrative office to pick up your ID card.
example.zh: 請到行政辦公室領取你的識別證。

examples.en: She works as an administrative assistant in our Taipei office.
examples.zh: 她在我們的台北辦公室擔任行政助理。

examples.en: Please send the form to the administrative department.
examples.zh: 請把表格寄給行政部門。

examples.en: Administrative costs rose by five percent this year.
examples.zh: 今年行政成本上升了百分之五。

examples.en: The administrative staff will hold a short meeting at nine.
examples.zh: 行政人員九點會開一個簡短的會議。

confusable.diff: administration 是名詞，指管理工作或行政部門；administrative 是形容詞。
confusable.usage: administrative 後面要接名詞（administrative work）；administration 本身就是名詞，不能再修飾名詞。

example.en: The administration approved the plan after a long review.
example.zh: 管理階層在長時間審查後核准了這項計畫。

example.en: The main office is on the third floor.
example.zh: 總辦公室在三樓。

example.en: Management plans to open two new stores next year.
example.zh: 管理階層計畫明年開兩家新店。

derived.link: 基礎動詞「管理」；去掉 -er 加上 -ative 就變成形容詞，像 talk → talkative
administer + -ation，管理這件事，像 inform → information

extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於電子郵件與回覆，表示對方的答覆是「是」或「同意」。語氣正式，常搭配 answer、reply、response，或用 in the affirmative 表示「回答是」。

example.en: The count showed nine affirmatives and only two negatives.
example.zh: 計票結果顯示九票贊成，只有兩票反對。

example.en: We need an affirmative response before the end of today.
example.zh: 我們今天結束前需要一個肯定的回覆。

example.en: The director replied in the affirmative within an hour.
example.zh: 主管在一小時內回覆說同意。

examples.en: We received an affirmative reply from the supplier this morning.
examples.zh: 我們今天早上收到供應商的肯定回覆。

examples.en: If the vote is affirmative, we will begin the project Monday.
examples.zh: 如果投票結果是贊成，我們星期一就開始這個專案。

confusable.diff: confirm 是「確認」某件事屬實或預約無誤；affirmative 是表示「是／同意」。
confusable.usage: confirm 是動詞，後面接受詞；affirmative 是形容詞或名詞，不能當動詞用。

example.en: Please confirm your flight time by email today.
example.zh: 請今天用電子郵件確認你的班機時間。

similar.diff: positive 比較口語，也可指正面的看法或結果；affirmative 專指表示「是」。

example.en: We got a positive reply from the new client.
example.zh: 我們收到新客戶正面的回覆。

similar.diff: favorable 指有利、讚許的態度；affirmative 單純是同意。

example.en: The committee gave a favorable report on our plan.
example.zh: 委員會對我們的計畫提出了正面的報告。

example.en: The customer sent a negative review about the delay.
example.zh: 客戶針對延誤寄來一則負面評論。

example.en: Both sides agree to meet again next week.
example.zh: 雙方同意下週再見面。

derived.link: 基礎動詞「堅定地表示」；加 -ative 變成形容詞，像 talk → talkative
affirm + -ation，肯定這件事，像 inform → information
affirmative + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

example.en: Her answer was affirmative, so we booked the conference room.
example.zh: 她的答覆是肯定的，所以我們訂了會議室。

example.en: We took her short nod as an affirmative.
example.zh: 我們把她簡單的點頭當作肯定的答覆。

extra_vocab.en: a vehicle with wings that flies and carries people
extra_vocab.note: 多益出差、機場與旅遊情境的基本字，常見於登機、延誤、航班公告。這是美式拼法，英式寫 aeroplane；口語常簡稱 plane。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「搭飛機」用 by airplane（或 by plane），by 後面不加 a／the；但 on an airplane 就要加冠詞。

example.en: Several airplanes landed late because of the heavy rain.
example.zh: 因為大雨，好幾架飛機都晚點降落。

example.en: Passengers may board the airplane after the final call.
example.zh: 最後廣播之後，旅客就可以登機。

example.en: Some goods are sent by airplane to save time.
example.zh: 有些貨物用飛機運送以節省時間。

example.en: I booked an airplane ticket for the business trip.
example.zh: 我為這次出差訂了機票。

examples.en: The airplane to Singapore leaves from Gate twelve at nine.
examples.zh: 飛往新加坡的飛機九點從十二號登機門出發。

examples.en: Please turn off your phone before the airplane takes off.
examples.zh: 飛機起飛前，請把手機關機。

examples.en: The airplane was delayed for two hours because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雨，飛機延誤了兩個小時。

confusable.diff: airplane 是飛機本身，airport 是機場。

example.en: We met our clients at the airport this morning.
example.zh: 我們今天早上在機場接了客戶。

confusable.diff: airline 是航空公司，不是飛機。

example.en: The airline offers cheap tickets to Seoul in spring.
example.zh: 這家航空公司在春天提供飛首爾的便宜機票。

similar.diff: plane 是 airplane 的口語簡稱，兩者意思相同。

example.en: I fell asleep on the plane to Chicago.
example.zh: 我在飛往芝加哥的飛機上睡著了。

similar.diff: aircraft 範圍更廣，包含直升機等，單複數同形；用於正式或技術情境。

example.en: The aircraft is checked carefully before every flight.
example.zh: 每次飛行前都會仔細檢查這架航空器。

example.en: Our flight to Paris leaves at noon on Friday.
example.zh: 我們飛巴黎的航班星期五中午起飛。

example.en: Each passenger may bring one small bag on board.
example.zh: 每位乘客可以帶一個小包包上機。

extra_vocab.en: very similar; in the same way
extra_vocab.note: 當形容詞時只能放在 be 動詞或 look 之後，說明兩者很像；當副詞時常放在句尾，表示「兩者都…」，像 customers and clients alike。多益閱讀中常以 A and B alike 的形式出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: alike 當形容詞不能直接放在名詞前（不能說 alike products）；要放前面用 similar。

example.en: The two models look alike, so check the label.
example.zh: 這兩款看起來很像，所以請檢查標籤。

example.en: Good business partners often think alike about new ideas.
example.zh: 好的事業夥伴對新點子的想法通常很接近。

example.en: The new rule affects customers and sellers alike.
example.zh: 這項新規定對顧客和賣家都有影響。

examples.en: Our two products are alike in price and quality.
examples.zh: 我們兩項產品在價格與品質上很相似。

examples.en: All employees, new and old alike, must attend the training.
examples.zh: 所有員工，無論新舊，都必須參加訓練。

confusable.diff: like 是介系詞「像」，後面接名詞；alike 後面不接受詞。
confusable.usage: A is like B，但 A and B are alike；alike 不能放在名詞前，也不接受詞。

example.en: This new laptop is like the one we bought.
example.zh: 這台新筆電和我們買過的那台很像。

similar.diff: similar 可放在名詞前（similar prices）；alike 不行。

example.en: Both stores have similar prices for office supplies.
example.zh: 兩家店的辦公用品價格很相近。

similar.diff: the same as 表示「完全一樣」，alike 只是很像。

example.en: Both reports give the same sales figures for May.
example.zh: 兩份報告給出的五月銷售數字完全一樣。

example.en: The two plans are very different from each other.
example.zh: 這兩個計畫彼此非常不同。

example.en: All workers receive equal pay for equal work.
example.zh: 所有員工同工同酬。

example.en: The two designs look very alike to me.
example.zh: 這兩個設計在我看來非常相像。

example.en: The course helps managers and staff alike.
example.zh: 這門課對經理與員工都有幫助。

extra_vocab.en: a day when you remember something that happened in an earlier year
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司週年慶、促銷活動與員工在職週年的情境，也可指結婚紀念日。常搭配序數，如 the tenth anniversary。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 第幾週年用序數加 anniversary，如 the 20th anniversary；後面接 of + 事件（anniversary of the opening）。

example.en: The firm holds events on several anniversaries each year.
example.zh: 這家公司每年在好幾個週年紀念日舉辦活動。

example.en: We will celebrate the anniversary with a small party on Friday.
example.zh: 我們星期五會用一個小派對慶祝週年。

example.en: Today is Tom's five-year work anniversary at our firm.
example.zh: 今天是 Tom 在我們公司的五週年。

example.en: He took a day off for his wedding anniversary.
example.zh: 他為了結婚紀念日請了一天假。

examples.en: Our company will mark its twentieth anniversary next month.
examples.zh: 我們公司下個月將迎來二十週年。

examples.en: Thank you for joining us on our store's anniversary.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在本店週年慶時與我們同在。

examples.en: We are offering a ten percent discount for our anniversary sale.
examples.zh: 週年慶期間我們提供九折優惠。

confusable.diff: annual 是形容詞「每年的」，anniversary 是名詞「週年紀念日」。
confusable.usage: annual 修飾名詞（annual meeting）；anniversary 本身是名詞，指某天。

example.en: The annual sales meeting is held every March in Taipei.
example.zh: 年度業務會議每年三月在台北舉行。

example.en: The celebration starts at six in the lobby.
example.zh: 慶祝活動六點在大廳開始。

example.en: The charity event attracted many local businesses last year.
example.zh: 這場慈善活動去年吸引了許多本地企業。

example.en: The award ceremony will begin at seven tonight in the hall.
example.zh: 頒獎典禮今晚七點在大廳開始。

extra_vocab.en: an old and valuable object, like furniture or a clock
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於拍賣、展覽、飯店裝潢與購物情境，指有歷史、有價值的老物件。名詞和形容詞拼法相同，常見搭配是 antique furniture 與 antique shop。

example.en: The store sells furniture and other antiques from Europe.
example.zh: 這家店賣來自歐洲的家具和其他古董。

example.en: The lobby is decorated with antique furniture from Italy.
example.zh: 大廳裝飾著來自義大利的古董家具。

example.en: She opened an antique shop near the train station.
example.zh: 她在火車站附近開了一家古董店。

example.en: He donated his antique collection to the city museum.
example.zh: 他把自己的古董收藏捐給市立博物館。

examples.en: The hotel bought an old mirror at an antique fair.
examples.zh: 飯店在古董市集買了一面舊鏡子。

examples.en: This antique vase is worth more than ten thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 這個古董花瓶價值超過一萬美元。

examples.en: Antique dealers often visit the weekend market in town.
examples.zh: 古董商常去鎮上的週末市集。

confusable.diff: ancient 指非常久遠的古代（如古羅馬），不一定是物品；antique 是有價值的老東西。
confusable.usage: ancient 是形容詞，不能當名詞用；antique 可以當名詞（an antique）。

example.en: Visitors enjoy the ancient temples near our hotel.
example.zh: 遊客喜歡我們飯店附近的古老寺廟。

similar.diff: vintage 常指某個年代的經典款（衣服、車、酒），antique 通常指更老、超過百年的物件。

example.en: She likes wearing vintage clothes from the 1980s.
example.zh: 她喜歡穿八〇年代的復古衣服。

example.en: The museum has a large collection of old maps.
example.zh: 博物館有大量的古地圖收藏。

example.en: The painting was sold at an auction yesterday.
example.zh: 那幅畫昨天在拍賣會上售出。

example.en: We need new furniture for the meeting room.
example.zh: 我們的會議室需要新家具。

example.en: This desk is an antique from the nineteenth century.
example.zh: 這張書桌是十九世紀的古董。

example.en: They bought an antique clock for the new lobby.
example.zh: 他們為新大廳買了一座古董鐘。

extra_vocab.en: a woman who acts in films, plays, or TV shows
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於廣告、活動、新聞與娛樂相關情境，指女性演員。現在很多人用 actor 泛指所有演員，但 actress 仍常用在獎項與介紹文字。

example.en: Two actresses signed contracts with the film studio this week.
example.zh: 兩位女演員這週和電影公司簽了約。

example.en: The leading actress will give a short speech at the event.
example.zh: 女主角會在活動上做一段簡短的演說。

example.en: We invited an award-winning actress to host the charity dinner.
example.zh: 我們邀請一位得獎女演員主持慈善晚宴。

example.en: She won the prize for best actress at the film festival.
example.zh: 她在影展上贏得最佳女主角獎。

examples.en: The company hired a famous actress for its new TV commercial.
examples.zh: 公司請了一位知名女演員拍新的電視廣告。

examples.en: The actress will attend the opening of our new store.
examples.zh: 這位女演員將出席我們新店的開幕。

confusable.diff: actor 是男演員，現在也常泛指所有演員；actress 專指女演員。

example.en: The actor in our new advertisement is a local student.
example.zh: 我們新廣告裡的演員是一位當地學生。

similar.diff: performer 泛指表演者，不限性別，也包含歌手、舞者等。

example.en: The performer thanked the audience after the show.
example.zh: 表演者在演出後向觀眾道謝。

example.en: The director chose a new actress for the main role.
example.zh: 導演為主角選了一位新的女演員。

example.en: The audience clapped loudly at the end of the play.
example.zh: 戲劇結束時，觀眾大聲鼓掌。

derived.link: 最基本的動詞，「演出」或「採取行動」
act + -or，做事的人，像 visitor、editor；actress 是 actor 的女性形
act + -ion，動作變名詞，像 decide → decision

extra_vocab.en: next to or very near something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於地點、建築、房間與停車場的描述，指兩個地方緊鄰。語氣正式，常出現在公告、廣告與房地產說明。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: adjacent 後面要接 to 再接地點（adjacent to the station），不是 adjacent with，也不能直接接名詞。

example.en: Our office is adjacent to the central train station.
example.zh: 我們的辦公室就在中央火車站旁邊。

example.en: The adjacent building is being repaired this month.
example.zh: 隔壁那棟大樓這個月正在整修。

examples.en: The meeting will be held in the adjacent conference room.
examples.zh: 會議將在隔壁的會議室舉行。

examples.en: Please use the adjacent parking lot after six o'clock.
examples.zh: 六點以後請使用隔壁的停車場。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近；adjust 是動詞「調整」，adjacent 是形容詞「鄰近的」。
confusable.usage: adjust 是動詞，後面接受詞；adjacent 是形容詞，要接 to 再接地點。

example.en: Please adjust the chair height before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 會議開始前，請先調整椅子的高度。

similar.diff: next to 比較口語，說「在…旁邊」；adjacent to 較正式。

example.en: The copy room is next to the manager's office.
example.zh: 影印室就在經理辦公室旁邊。

similar.diff: nearby 只表示附近，不一定緊貼；adjacent 通常是相連或緊鄰。

example.en: Several restaurants are nearby, so lunch is easy.
example.zh: 附近有好幾家餐廳，所以午餐很方便。

example.en: The new store has a very good location.
example.zh: 新店的地點非常好。

example.en: Our neighbor company shares the same parking lot.
example.zh: 我們隔壁的公司和我們共用同一個停車場。

extra_vocab.zh: 入場許可、入場費；入學；承認
extra_vocab.en: the right to enter a place, or the money you pay to enter
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於展覽、博物館與活動公告，指「入場」或「入場費」，也可指學校或課程的「錄取」。另外可表示承認錯誤。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示入場或入學時用 admission to + 地點／學校；表示承認時用 admission of + 錯誤。admission 作入場費時是不可數名詞。

example.en: The admissions office opens at eight on weekdays.
example.zh: 招生辦公室平日八點開門。

example.en: The admission fee includes a guide and a small gift.
example.zh: 入場費包含導覽和一份小禮物。

example.en: Children under six get free admission to the exhibition.
example.zh: 六歲以下兒童可免費參觀展覽。

example.en: Please show your admission ticket at the main gate.
example.zh: 請在大門出示你的入場券。

examples.en: Admission to the trade show is free for registered guests.
examples.zh: 已登記的來賓可免費進入貿易展。

examples.en: Admission starts at nine, and the museum closes at five.
examples.zh: 九點開始入場，博物館五點關閉。

examples.en: She applied for admission to a business school in Boston.
examples.zh: 她申請了波士頓一所商學院的入學許可。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近；permission 是「被允許做某事」，admission 是「被允許進入」。

example.en: You need permission from your manager to leave early.
example.zh: 你要得到經理的許可才能提早離開。

similar.diff: entry 指進入的動作或入口，範圍較廣；admission 強調被准許進入或入場費。

example.en: Entry to the lab is only for staff members.
example.zh: 只有員工可以進入實驗室。

example.en: The ticket office sells concert tickets until six o'clock.
example.zh: 售票處賣演唱會門票到六點。

example.en: The hotel charges a small fee for late checkout.
example.zh: 飯店對延遲退房收取一筆小額費用。

derived.link: 基礎動詞；admit → admission，像 permit → permission
admit + -ance，允許進入的權利，像 attend → attendance

senses.en: the right or price to enter a place

example.en: The price of admission includes a free drink.
example.zh: 入場費包含一杯免費飲料。

senses.en: the act of letting someone join a school or program
senses.distinguish: 後面接學校、課程或組織，常和 apply for 一起用。

example.en: Admission to the training program depends on your test score.
example.zh: 能否進入訓練課程要看你的測驗分數。

senses.en: a statement that you did something wrong or that something is true
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 of + 錯誤或事實。

example.en: His admission of the error helped us fix it quickly.
example.zh: 他承認錯誤，讓我們很快就修正了。

extra_vocab.en: at a later time, after something has happened
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於行程、會議與公告，說明某件事之後接著發生什麼，多放在句尾或逗號後。美式拼法是 afterward，英式常寫 afterwards，意思相同。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: afterward 是副詞，後面不直接接名詞；要說「在…之後」請用 after + 名詞（after the meeting）。

example.en: The meeting ended, and shortly afterward the manager left.
example.zh: 會議結束，不久之後經理就離開了。

example.en: The new store opened, and soon afterward sales went up.
example.zh: 新店開幕，隨後不久銷售就上升了。

examples.en: Please finish the report first; we can discuss it afterward.
examples.zh: 請先完成報告，我們之後再討論。

examples.en: We will visit the factory and have lunch afterward.
examples.zh: 我們會先參觀工廠，之後再吃午餐。

examples.en: I will explain the plan now and take questions afterward.
examples.zh: 我現在先說明計畫，之後再接受提問。

confusable.diff: after 是介系詞或連接詞，後面接名詞或子句；afterward 是副詞，單獨使用。
confusable.usage: after 後面要接東西（after the meeting）；afterward 後面不接名詞，常放句尾。

example.en: After the meeting, we will have lunch together.
example.zh: 會議結束後，我們會一起吃午餐。

similar.diff: later 範圍較廣，單純指「晚一點」；afterward 是在某件事之後。

example.en: I will send the file later this afternoon.
example.zh: 我今天下午晚一點會寄出檔案。

similar.diff: then 較口語，常連接依序發生的動作；afterward 語氣較正式。

example.en: We reviewed the budget, and then we voted on it.
example.zh: 我們先檢視預算，然後對它進行投票。

example.en: Please send me the agenda beforehand so I can prepare.
example.zh: 請事先把議程寄給我，讓我可以準備。

example.en: Meanwhile, the sales team is preparing the next report.
example.zh: 同時，業務團隊正在準備下一份報告。
